subject: Re: MAP Draft & SOC 2 package delivery - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Michael Tan <michael.tan@aureliatech.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@aureliatech.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft & SOC 2 package delivery - post-demo recap

Hi Michael / Samantha,

Thanks again for the demo earlier - great conversation. Per our call, I've attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (RD_MAP_AureliaTech_v1.2.pdf) that captures milestones, owners, and target dates. The immediate MAP milestone is the security review / SOC 2 evidence delivery so your security team can complete its assessment.

Key items in the MAP draft (high level):
- Security review kickoff (Aurelia Tech) - target: 2026-07-31
- SOC 2 package delivery (Redwood) - target: 2026-08-06
- Contract finalization & legal review - target: 2026-08-13
- Pilot kickoff / integration testing - target: 2026-08-20

Actions from our side:
- I attached the SOC 2 summary and an evidence manifest (SOC2_Evidence_Manifest.xlsx). If you can confirm which evidence items you need access to first, we'll prioritize delivery.
- Neha (SE) will coordinate any technical walkthroughs / evidence extraction.
- Vivek (Security) is on copy for any encryption/KMS or network questions.

Michael can you confirm the internal reviewer and whether the 08/06 delivery date works for you? Also flag any additional compliance artifacts (e.g., pen test report, data retention policy) you want included in the package.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: RD_MAP_AureliaTech_v1.2.pdf, SOC2_Evidence_Manifest.xlsx

From: Michael Tan <michael.tan@aureliatech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@aureliatech.com>, security@aureliatech.com
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & SOC 2 package delivery - post-demo recap

Marissa, thanks for the recap and the MAP. The dates look reasonable. A few notes from our side:

1) Internal reviewer: Samantha Lee will own the review and coordinate with our security team (cc'ed). She'll confirm availability for a kickoff on 7/31 by EOD today.

2) Evidence priority: please prioritize the following items from the manifest: SOC 2 cover letter, encryption key management docs, access control list exports, and network segmentation diagrams. If you can send those first (even as PDFs) it will help speed our intake.

3) Additional artifacts: we would like the most recent penetration test report (if available) and your data retention policy. Those are not blockers but helpful.

4) Delivery mechanism: secure link (Drive) is fine for now, but for any high-sensitivity artifacts we'll request a temporary S3 share or a signed DocuSign acknowledgement.

Confirming target: SOC 2 package delivery by 2026-08-06 is acceptable pending the kickoff.

Thanks,
Michael
Director of IT Security | Aurelia Tech
michael.tan@aureliatech.com
+1 (206) 555-0420

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Michael Tan <michael.tan@aureliatech.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@aureliatech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & SOC 2 package delivery - evidence priority

Hi Michael / Samantha - looping in Vivek from our security team.

We'll prioritize the items you listed. Plan:
- Today: I'll pull the SOC 2 cover letter, encryption/KMS docs, and ACL export snapshots and upload to a secure Drive folder.
- Thu (7/30): Vivek and I can run a short tech walkthrough (30 minutes) to walk through the network segmentation diagrams and the ACLs; we can also answer any follow-ups on the pen test.
- Fri (8/6): Full manifest delivery (per MAP) including the SOC 2 report excerpts and data retention policy.

Vivek can you confirm availability for a 30-minute slot tomorrow between 9-11am PT? Samantha / Michael what time zone works best for you?

Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Michael Tan <michael.tan@aureliatech.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@aureliatech.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & SOC 2 package delivery - finalizing delivery plan

Hi all - quick update following internal sync.

1) Kickoff: Samantha confirmed internally that 7/31 at 10:00am PT works; I've added a calendar invite.
2) Interim delivery: Neha has uploaded the prioritized artifacts to the secure Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAP-AureliaTech (link above). Items uploaded: SOC 2 cover letter, KMS/key rotation docs, ACL export snapshots, network diagrams.
3) Pen test report: We have a redacted pen test summary included in redwood-soc2-summary.pdf. For the full report, we'll follow your S3 share + NDA process. Rishi will coordinate if needed.
4) MAP update: I've updated the MAP to reflect the confirmed kickoff and interim delivery milestones. Please find the updated MAP attached (RD_MAP_AureliaTech_v1.2.pdf).

Next steps / asks:
- Samantha: confirm the 7/31 invite and any additional reviewers to add to the call.
- Michael: confirm whether you want the full pen test delivered via S3 + DocuSign (I'll have Rishi start the process).
- Neha & Vivek: be on the kickoff call tomorrow for the tech walkthrough.

Thanks all - we're on track for the 2026-08-06 full package delivery per the MAP.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: RD_MAP_AureliaTech_v1.2.pdf, SOC2_Evidence_Manifest.xlsx
